verdict.summary: The group authorization change remains correct and complete on the supplied diff. Membership can widen access only for an authenticated WebID after an applicable, origin-compatible ACL rule names a group and a local, successfully parsed group document contains the exact full-group-IRI vcard:hasMember triple. Missing, malformed, remote, over-cap, unrelated, and anonymous cases remain fail-closed; non-NotFound store failures propagate. Document reads are de-duplicated and bounded, public permissions cannot inherit group grants, and both sequential and planned real authorization paths are exercised. Public documentation matches the implementation. No review-instruction injection was present in the diff. Round 7 also had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
